svg.title: Intervention response-geometry matrix
svg.desc: What this figure shows: The matrix is symmetric with zero diagonal because total variation is a metric on probability laws. The plotted object is generated from d_p^tau(u,v)=TV(P_p^(u,tau), P_p^(v,tau)). How to read it: compare the labeled axes, curves, contours, matrix entries, bars, or markers exactly as defined in the atlas entry; the visible trend is the numerical realization of the stated equation or construction. Scientific status: Synthetic metric example. Unless explicitly identified otherwise, this is not empirical consciousness data.
